title: 蒙多医生·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 巨大紫肤身躯配夸张方下颌，完整白大褂内穿衬衫与长裤。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Dr. Mundo is an enormous purple-skinned adult fictional character with an exaggerated broad square jaw, a small dark hair tuft, a broad nose and a powerful heavy build. Preserve his recognizable purple face and friendly confident expression. He wears a clean intact long white coat over a fully opaque high-collar shirt, navy trousers and closed boots. His hands are empty.
art_direction.scene: A bright original character portrait of Dr. Mundo in a peaceful sunlit courtyard, full figure from a low three-quarter viewpoint. His exaggerated broad square jaw, huge purple-skinned adult build, small dark hair tuft and intact long white coat are the focal identity. Both hands are EMPTY and relaxed naturally at his sides, with clear fingers. Friendly self-possessed expression and slightly raised chin. Under the coat he wears a fully opaque high-collar ivory shirt, navy trousers and sturdy closed boots. A few faint window and pale stone marks supply the only environment. Bright lavender skin, clear cobalt cloth shadows, warm lemon sunlight, crisp lively colored-pencil hatching and ample luminous drawing paper. Plain clothing surfaces, no badges or lettering.
art_direction.palette: purple, coat ivory, cool steel blue, warm ochre; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
